scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/desktop/frontend && bun run build && cd .. && go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o build/bin/drift-backend . && cd electron && bun run build && bun x electron-builder --dir
scripts.bindings: cd apps/desktop && go run . -bindings frontend/src/lib/backend/generated && prettier --write --log-level warn frontend/src/lib/backend/generated
scripts.test: cd core && go test ./... && cd ../apps/desktop && go test ./...
scripts.lint: bun run lint:go && bun run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:go: cd core && golangci-lint run && cd ../apps/desktop && golangci-lint run
scripts.lint:frontend: prettier --check . && cd apps/desktop/frontend && bun run lint && bun run check && cd ../electron && bun run check
scripts.format:go: cd core && golangci-lint fmt && cd ../apps/desktop && golangci-lint fmt
scripts.android:start: bun run android:install && adb shell am start -n dev.neoworks.ottermusic/.MainActivity
scripts.test:live: cd core && go test -tags live -run Live -v ./...
